messages:
anya: heads up — CI is red on the integration/kv-cache job, looks like a decrypt/access error from KMS during secrets fetch. failing since ~10:02 UTC

mike: gist of the error? can you paste the tail of the job log?

anya: here's the snippet:
```
ERROR: secrets.fetch: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get: Caller does not have permission
Service Account: project-ci@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

frank: hm, org IAM cleanup ran last night. we moved service accounts to a narrower role, might have removed kms.viewer from the CI SA by accident.

lisa: if that's true we should not re-add perms without an audit. can someone check the admin activity log for the binding change?

anya: checking now, gcloud audit shows a binding removal at 2026-03-17T03:07:21Z by infra-iam-bot — likely our scripted cleanup.

mike: easy workaround to get CI unblocked: can we rerun the job in a mode that uses a fallback secrets path (vault token injected) while we triage IAM? otherwise request a temporary binding restore.

frank: I can re-add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to the CI SA for the specific key and scope for 30 minutes, then remove. If you want I can do that and we can rerun.

lisa: +1 on temporary scoped grant, but record in the ticket and add the justification. Also mark the change as timeboxed.

anya: ok please do the restore, frank. will run a quick bisect after rerun to find first bad commit in case something else regressed.

frank: re-added binding to key `projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/kv-cache/cryptoKeys/default` for `project-ci@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` — expiry set to 30m.

dev-ci-bot: Re-run requested by @anya for workflow: integration/kv-cache (run id 6789) — started.

mike: if rerun passes, we still need to update the IAM cleanup script to skip that SA or key. filing infra-iam ticket now.

anya: rerun passed ✅ but I'll still bisect through the last 20 commits to be sure. will post results here. :thumbsup:

lisa: thanks, team. can someone add the audit link + ticket number to the PR that changes the cleanup script?

frank: filed TICKET-1428 and attached the audit log. linking in PR after bisect.

anya: bisect found the change that tightened SA roles three commits ago, PR#5021. tagging infra-iam for follow-up. closing this thread once PR links are added.

mike: nice work, thanks all. :tada:
